svg.aria-label: NYC Hazard Historian — Data Flow: Federal and city source records, through a five-stage pipeline, into a filterable event archive
svg.title: NYC Hazard Historian — Data Flow
svg.desc: Federal and city source records, through a five-stage pipeline, into a filterable event archive. Eight sources feed a five-stage pipeline governed by a single config file; the pipeline writes JSON and CSV outputs that the static site reads, except radar tiles, which the browser fetches live and which bypass the pipeline entirely.
